title: Hoshino Ichika — Star Piece Connection〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good morning, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Morning, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning to both of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry about not being able to make it to your show yesterday. But thank you for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's okay. We know that you were busy with your stream.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You were nice enough to cheer for us by text instead, which helped fire us up!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Minori sent us a lot of stamps too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, she did! A bunch of different characters saying, “You can do it!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I was with her when she sent those, so I had her send some in my place.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Now it makes sense!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So how'd your show go?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We managed.
The crowd seemed pretty into it too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Bravo, huge success♪
Is what I want to call it but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Nobody still knows who we are so it's only natural.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But get this! We sounded awesome when we played our original song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And as we practice playing it more, it might even start becoming something that can really touch people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see.
Hehe. I'll be looking forward to your next show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
Do you remember that advice you gave me the other day, Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What advice?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, I told her the other day about how I was having trouble writing lyrics for our song and said that I should just take things one step at a time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By doing that, I'd be able to see my progress in real-time and even figure out what's giving me trouble.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's pretty cool!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it really is. Soon after that, I found out exactly why I wasn't happy with what I was doing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, really. I was so convinced that I needed to make my lyrics rhyme well or sound cool.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I mean, sure, some of the stuff I write comes out a little vague, but they're written that way because that's what I felt was best.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I try to find the right words for the best way of expressing my thoughts. That's all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was scared of just saying how I felt. I was scared of feeling embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In a way, I didn't have any confidence in just showing who the “real me” is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I thought what you came up with in the end was totally you, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Your lyrics are an absolute 100% perfect match for my song♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-Saki!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our real selves...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've actually been thinking about that and me as just a regular high schooler.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, like Haruka Kiritani the idol versus Haruka Kiritani the girl?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I was sure that I'd been separating my personal and professional lives well until now, but my groupmates showed me that I really wasn't.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you just seem like you whenever we have lunch together...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, and I believe that I am just being me right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But being an idol has become so ingrained in my life that I can't really detach myself from it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sometimes, I have trouble making that switch between the idol me and regular me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I can empathize a little with how you felt about showing who you are through your lyrics, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I never thought that Haruka Kiritani would be bothered by something like that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In a way, I'm sort of glad that you're no different from the rest of us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you're both super cute just the way you are, so I don't think there's anything to be embarrassed about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kiritani, sure. But me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
That puzzled look you just gave me is absolutely adorable♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? Okay, no more. You're gonna make me blush.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, before I forget.
Do you know when your next show is going to be?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, not yet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, would you mind letting me know when you do? I'd love to be there to cheer you on.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure Minori, Airi and Shizuku would be too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, totally!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure Shizuku's dying to see her sister play.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Very true. She'll be her number one fan.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shiiiii!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But this is so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We might actually get a chance to do a show with professional idols in the crowd!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. We'll need to keep practicing to make sure they see a good show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You don't need to give us any special treatment.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, our goal is to make and play music that can move people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Original songs included.
I want more people to hear our music.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So let's keep giving it our best, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!
